newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech finmin says govt must consider bank selloffs.
newsitem.headline: Czech finmin says govt must consider bank selloffs.

text.p: Czech Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik said on Thursday the government must quickly formulate a strategy for privatising state-held shares in the country's four largest banks.

"We have to something with the privatisation of banks, and we have to do it fast," Kocarnik told reporters. "I'm speaking about the strategy now, not individual banks, on which decisions should be taken afterwards."
Kocarnik said several major U.S. houses had been lobbying him on the issue during his recent trip to Washington.

"All the world's big banks asked for a meeting, including JP Morgan, Merrill Lynch, Salomon Brothers, and the question they strongly put forward always was: 'When will you privatise the banks?'," Kocarnik said.
The minister added that his ministry and the central bank were "getting closer" in their opinions concerning bank privatisations.
